name: What are common safety considerations for electrical fixture installation?
description: Safety considerations include turning off power, using correct wiring and grounding, and ensuring proper fixture support to prevent hazards like fires or shocks

mainEntity.name: What are common safety considerations for electrical fixture installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common safety considerations for electrical fixture installation include ensuring the power is completely shut off at the circuit breaker before beginning work, using correctly rated wiring and junction boxes, and properly grounding all fixtures. Incorrect wiring can lead to electrical fires or shocks. It is also crucial to ensure the fixture's weight is adequately supported, especially for heavy items like chandeliers. As a professional contractor, Frasheski Construction prioritizes safety by adhering to all National Electrical Code (NEC) standards and local regulations during every installation.
